name: core--bg-laws-deploy
description: Deploys the bg-laws pipeline runtime to vm700 per bg-laws-pipeline/docs/spec/80-queue-worker-admin.md section 4: bglaws user (no sudo), bun from the official tarball at /usr/local/bin/bun, git clones of bg-laws-pipeline and the bg-laws data repo under /opt/bg-laws, the var/queue + var/admin state dirs, a 0600 env file (no LLM key on the host — OPENROUTER_API_KEY referenced but empty by default), backfill.sh + incremental.sh wrappers sharing one flock file, a daily incremental cron in /etc/cron.d, and logrotate for /opt/bg-laws/logs. The backfill itself is NOT started by the role — it is operator-started inside tmux, once.

implementation.change: Role bg-laws (tasks, defaults, templates for env/backfill.sh/incremental.sh/start-backfill.sh/cron/logrotate/ssh_config), wired into the ops play of playbook-index.yaml under tag bg_laws. Private repos are cloned over ssh with DEDICATED per-repo GitHub deploy keys (ticket 37): protected/keys/bg-laws/bg-laws-pipeline-deploy.key (read-only on k0eff/bg-laws-pipeline) and bg-laws-data-deploy.key (read-write on k0eff/bg-laws — the runner pushes legal commits from vm700). Host aliases github.com-bg-laws-{pipeline,data} in the bglaws ~/.ssh/config pin the right IdentityFile, so cron-driven fetch/push works with no ansible around; the clone URLs use the aliases. Wrappers call absolute /usr/local/bin/bun (QA-303 — cron PATH misses /usr/local/bin). Repo updates are fetch + ff-only merge under flock -n so a running backfill is never yanked out from under itself; the data repo is never merged at all (the runner owns that tree, spec 4.7).
